text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy informed Symboli Kris S of 
her entry in the Arima Kinen. There, 
learning of her feelings that "she has no 
regrets about retiring"—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's true feelings spill over. 
She doesn't want to end up as just another 
face in the crowd to her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely win the Arima Kinen. I 
want to be—I will be—your one and only 
lingering regret. That was her 
declaration.
